title: The Poisoned Vapor
logline: When a toxic sedative leak in a refinery sector knocks out an entire shift, a station physician hires an outsider to discover who opened the ventilation bypass.

roles.description: The overworked chief of industrial emergency medicine; cynical, vigilant, treating chemical burns with steady hands.
A brilliant atmospheric engineer who compromised the ventilation grid to help a sibling escape from corporate indenture.
The chemical extraction ward where dozens of refinery workers are recovering from inhalation poisoning.
The central circulation junction linking the industrial refinery to the station's main life support.
The heavy industry syndicate that owns the fuel synthesis crackers and treats worker health as an operating expense.
A criminal network operating covert extraction routes through the station's unmonitored exhaust flues.
A fast, stealth-shielded transport waiting in the exhaust shadow to extract the fugitive.

public_situation: A sudden chemical vapor leak in {system}'s fuel cracking facility hospitalizes forty workers and leaves the industrial district under emergency seal.
private_truth: The chemist introduced synthetic neuro-sedative into the air ducts to incapacitate security patrols so a fugitive relative could slip into an exhaust cutter.

beats.public_change: Hazard teams seal off the fuel crackers while hospital sirens echo through the upper residential tiers.

missions.reason: The doctor needs an outsider to scan the ventilation mixing chambers and identify whether the vapor was industrial exhaust or military-grade gas.
missions.private_fact: Toxicology scans confirm the compound was an exotic anesthetic never stocked in the refinery's official medical inventory.

beats.public_change: A sensor ping detects an unregistered cutter burning away from the station's primary cooling flue.

missions.reason: The physician hires the pilot to disable the fleeing cutter and recover its flight logs before the vessel jumps clear of the system.
missions.private_fact: The cutter crew is armed with syndicate security hardware and was hired specifically to extract the chemist's indentured sister.

beats.public_change: The recovered logs expose the chemist's role, but the consortium threatens to declare the entire ward a contagion quarantine zone.

missions.reason: The doctor asks the pilot to courier antidote synthesizing enzymes to the ward before the consortium cuts emergency power to the beds.
missions.private_fact: The chemist has surrendered to the clinic and is offering full testimony in exchange for sanctuary for the rescued sibling.

beats.public_change: With the patients stabilized, consortium executives arrive with an armed security detail to reclaim the chemist and erase the logs.

missions.reason: The doctor needs the pilot to collect the chemist's signed confession and chemical samples directly from the clinic before security storms the ward.
missions.private_fact: The consortium director personally authorized hazardous shifts with known faulty seals, making the company liable for massive damages.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the chemist's confession and the toxic samples. The consortium offers a massive settlement to burn the proof, while the physician demands justice for the poisoned shift.

options.label: Hand the evidence to station magistrates to indict the consortium and protect the chemist
Surrender the evidence to consortium executives for a quiet six-figure settlement
Trade the logs to the syndicate in exchange for permanent safe passage for the chemist's family

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the confession and samples to the magistrates.
resolutions.summary: {role:refinery_consortium} is fined millions for safety neglect; {role:station_physician} secures worker medical funds while {role:desperate_chemist} enters protective custody.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot carried the proof that exposed corporate gas leaks and protected poisoned refinery workers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the consortium's settlement payout.
resolutions.summary: {role:refinery_consortium} buries the incident as an accidental filter failure; {role:station_physician} is silenced while {role:desperate_chemist} is quietly arrested.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot trades the logs to the syndicate for family escape.
resolutions.summary: {role:desperate_chemist} and her sister escape into the outer belt under syndicate protection, leaving {role:refinery_consortium} and {role:station_physician} in bitter gridlock.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot drops the contract or fails the interception.
resolutions.summary: The consortium seals the wards under quarantine; {role:desperate_chemist} disappears and {role:station_physician} loses hospital operating privileges.

loose_threads.detail: Debris from the intercept cutter contains aerosol dispersal valves marked with a syndicate laboratory insignia.
A bounty for an escaped refinery apprentice was posted three hours before the gas leak was officially discovered.

radio_hooks: Forty refinery crew treated for acute vapor inhalation in {system} industrial sector.
Syndicate executives deny rumors of intentional nerve toxin discharge in fuel refinery.
Health union in {system} calls for independent environmental inspection of cooling flues.

voice_direction.station_physician: Tired, clinical, clipped, reciting medical readings with fierce suppressed anger. Refuses to sugarcoat patient prognosis.
voice_direction.desperate_chemist: Frantic, guilt-ridden, speaking in rapid rationalizations about familial loyalty while terrified of corporate retribution.
